name: ac-emerging-market-access
description: Getting exposure to an emerging market through the route that actually works: depositary receipts and their ratios, local shares and the access channels for foreign investors, quotas and registration regimes, capital controls and repatriation, settlement and custody differences, index inclusion and the flows that tracking funds create, onshore currency access, conversion cost and deliverable versus non-deliverable forwards, and the written access record. It evaluates the route to the exposure; it never recommends a market and never predicts a currency. Use when asking "ADR", "GDR", "how do I buy local shares", "capital controls", "repatriation", "QFII", "index inclusion", "emerging market access", "premium on the ADR", "why can't I sell this". Not for currency exposure in a portfolio (ac-currency-and-fx-risk), not for convertibility and devaluation risk analysis (ac-currency-and-fx-risk), not for the equity investment case (ac-equity-research).
